prompt: Part I. Let $X_1, X_2, \dots$ be independent and $S_n = \sum_{m=1}^n X_m$.
parts: (i) Use the Lindeberg-Feller CLT to show that if $\sup_m |X_m| < \infty$ a.s. and $\sum_m \operatorname{Var}(X_m) = \infty$, then $(S_n - \mathbb{E} S_n)/\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(S_n)} \xrightarrow{d} N(0, 1)$.
(ii) Construct an explicit example where $(S_n - \mathbb{E} S_n)/\sqrt{n} \xrightarrow{d} N(0,1)$ holds but $\operatorname{Var}(S_n)/n$ does not converge to $1$.

parts: (i) Construct the UMP test for $H_0 : \theta \le \theta_0$ vs $H_1 : \theta > \theta_0$.
(ii) Prove the test in (i) is uniformly most powerful.
(iii) Prove or disprove the existence of a UMP test for $H_0 : \theta = \theta_0$ vs $H_1 : \theta \ne \theta_0$.

prompt: Part III, Problem 2 (50 pts). Let $X_1, \dots, X_n$ be i.i.d. with density $p_\theta(\cdot)$; let $l_n(\theta)$ be the negative log-likelihood with Hessian $H_n(\theta)$, regularity conditions satisfied.

prompt: Part III, Problem 3 (25 pts). Let $\{(X_i, Y_i, R_i)\}_{i=1}^n$ be i.i.d. with covariates $X_i \in \mathbb{R}^d$, response $Y_i$, and missingness indicator $R_i \in \{0, 1\}$ ($R_i = 1$ if $Y_i$ observed). Assume (a) $Y_i \mid X_i, R_i = 1 \stackrel{d}{=} Y_i \mid X_i, R_i = 0$, and (b) $X_i \mid R_i = 1 \sim P_X$, $X_i \mid R_i = 0 \sim Q_X$ (possibly different). Target: $\beta^* = \arg\min_\beta \mathbb{E}[(Y_i - X_i^\top\beta)^2 \mid R_i = 0]$.
parts: (iii) Apply (i) and (ii) to construct an estimator of $\beta^*$.
notes: 2025 unified theory exam, Part III. Transcribed from extracted text.

prompt: Part IV. Observe i.i.d. $(X_i, Y_i)$ with $\mathbb{E}(Y \mid X) = X^T\beta^*$; split $X = (Z, W^T)^T$, $\beta^* = (\theta^*, \alpha^{*T})^T$ with $Z, \theta^*$ scalar and $Z$ binary. Let $\hat\beta$ be the Lasso-penalized least squares estimator, and $\hat\gamma$ the Lasso-penalized logistic-regression estimator of $Z$ on $W$. Consider the debiased estimator $\tilde\theta = \frac{(Z - \mathrm{expit}(W\hat\gamma))^T(Y - W\hat\alpha)/n}{(Z - \mathrm{expit}(W\hat\gamma))^T Z/n}$, with $\mathrm{expit}(u) = e^u/(1 + e^u)$. The goal is the asymptotic expansion $\tilde\theta - \theta^* = \frac{(Z - \mathrm{expit}(W\bar\gamma))^T(Y - Z\theta^* - W\alpha^*)/n}{(Z - \mathrm{expit}(W\bar\gamma))^T Z/n} + o_p(n^{-1/2})$, reducing to establishing equation (4) in the exam.
parts: 1) Show $|(Z - \mathrm{expit}(W\hat\gamma))^T(Y - Z\theta^* - W\hat\alpha)/n - (Z - \mathrm{expit}(W\bar\gamma))^T(Y - Z\theta^* - W\alpha^*)/n| \le \underbrace{|(Z - \mathrm{expit}(W\hat\gamma))^T W(\hat\alpha - \alpha^*)/n|}_{I} + \underbrace{|(\mathrm{expit}(W\hat\gamma) - \mathrm{expit}(W\bar\gamma))^T(Y - Z\theta^* - W\alpha^*)/n|}_{II}$.

2) Show, under suitable conditions, $I = O_p(1)(|S_{\beta^*}| + |S_{\bar\gamma}|)\frac{\log(n\vee p)}{n}$. State the conditions explicitly (you may use standard $\hat\beta, \hat\gamma$ rate properties).

3) Show that for any $u, \tilde u \in \mathbb{R}$: $|\mathrm{expit}_2(u) - \mathrm{expit}_2(\tilde u)| \le \mathrm{expit}_2(\tilde u)|u - \tilde u|$ and $|\mathrm{expit}(u) - \mathrm{expit}(\tilde u) - \mathrm{expit}_2(\tilde u)(u - \tilde u)| \le \mathrm{expit}_2(\tilde u)(u - \tilde u)^2$, where $\mathrm{expit}_2(u) = \mathrm{expit}(u)(1 - \mathrm{expit}(u))$.

4) Assume $Y - Z\theta^* - W^T\alpha^*$ is bounded by $B_0$ a.s. Show under suitable (explicitly stated) conditions that $II = O_p(1)(|S_{\beta^*}| + |S_{\bar\gamma}|)\frac{\log(n\vee p)}{n}$. (Combining 1,2,4 gives (4) when $(|S_{\beta^*}| + |S_{\bar\gamma}|)\frac{\log(n\vee p)}{\sqrt n} = o(1)$.)
notes: 2025 unified theory exam, Part IV (Stat 594). Transcribed from extracted text.
